title: Strichstärken & Abstände
slide_intent: Keep stroke and gap relationships consistent so small symbols do not lose their internal structure.
strategic_value: A shared 2 dp construction can align DB icon weight across subjects.
demonstration: Magnifier and calendar diagrams label stroke thickness and minimum spacing beneath a rule paragraph.
practical_value: Use 2 dp strokes and gaps; simplify before reducing a gap to 1 dp when no further simplification is possible.

content_islands.name: Rule paragraph
content_islands.spec: State the default and the order of small-size exceptions above the examples.

content_islands.name: Dimension examples
content_islands.spec: Pair the magnifier stroke callout with calendar gap callouts.

reference_purposes.Constraint: Stroke is 2 dp and minimum gap 2 dp; reduce complexity first, then allow 1 dp gap only if further reduction is impossible.
reference_purposes.Application: Two labeled examples show where thickness and spacing are measured.

ingredient.name: Icon stroke and gap
ingredient.role: Maintain even weight and open internal spaces.
ingredient.application: Use 2 dp strokes and 2 dp minimum gaps; reduce complexity before a 1 dp gap exception.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. The 1 dp exception applies only when the icon cannot be simplified further.
